description: This file implements classes and methods for handling MAC UL SCH PDU and subPDU structures, including unpacking and parsing logic for subPDUs in a 3GPP-like protocol stack.

classes.name: mac_ul_sch_subpdu
classes.description: Represents a subPDU in the MAC UL SCH protocol, with methods for unpacking and parsing subPDUs.

classes.name: mac_ul_sch_pdu
classes.description: Represents a MAC UL SCH PDU containing multiple subPDUs, with methods for unpacking and clearing subPDUs.

methods.name: mac_ul_sch_subpdu::unpack
methods.description: Unpacks a subPDU from a byte buffer or reader, parsing header fields and payload.

methods.name: mac_ul_sch_pdu::unpack
methods.description: Unpacks a MAC UL SCH PDU from a byte buffer, extracting multiple subPDUs.
